Guidance: Unique identifier for the change request (e.g., CR-01).
Change category (Scope, Schedule, Cost, Quality, Resource).
Summary description of the proposed change.
Name or department submitting the change request.
Date the change request was formally submitted.
Current lifecycle state of the request (Submitted, Under Review, Approved, Rejected).
Decision made by the Change Control Board (CCB).
Estimated financial and timeline impact of the change.
Whether the change is legally mandatory or discretionary.
Configuration items, baselines, or specifications affected.
